en-US.name: Follow Builders
en-US.summary: Curate AI-builder updates from a public podcast, X and blog feed. Requires networking; scripts need Node.js/npm dependencies. Telegram or email delivery needs separately configured accounts and authorization.
en-US.description: The pinned README.md License section declares MIT; this snapshot has no standalone LICENSE file. The declaration concerns upstream code; public-feed and third-party content retain their respective rights and service terms. On-demand summaries can stay in chat. Scripts require separately installed Node.js and dependencies. Telegram/Resend delivery requires operator credentials, applicable fees and explicit send/schedule authorization. Report unavailable feeds, dependencies or permissions.

zh-CN.name: Follow Builders
zh-CN.summary: 追踪 AI 开发者、研究者与创始人的公开动态，整理播客、X 和博客摘要。需联网；脚本另需 Node.js 和 npm 依赖，Telegram/邮件推送需自备账号并授权。
zh-CN.description: 固定快照 README.md 的 License 一节声明 MIT，仓库未提供独立 LICENSE 文件。该声明针对上游代码，公共信源与第三方文章的使用遵循各自权利和服务条款。按需阅读可直接在聊天中整理，脚本需另装 Node.js 和依赖；Telegram/Resend 推送需自备凭据、确认费用并授权发送或定时。信源、依赖或权限不可用时说明阻碍。

requirements.value: Access to the upstream public digest feed. Feed availability and data licensing are governed by its operator.

Node.js with built-in fetch support is needed for scripts; install the separately declared dotenv ^16.4.0 and proper-lockfile ^4.1.0 dependencies before use. Telegram/email delivery uses the operator's Telegram Bot or Resend credentials, product terms and applicable fees, with explicit sending/scheduling authorization. Without these prerequisites, stay in on-demand chat mode or report the blocker.
